newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala Land B down 4.8 pct at 29.50 pesos.
newsitem.headline: Ayala Land B down 4.8 pct at 29.50 pesos.

text.p: Ayala Land B shares dropped by 1.50 pesos, or 4.84 percent, to 29.50 by mid-session on Thursday.
Fritz Aclan, research head at Dharmala Securities (Phils) Inc, said the drop in ALI B shares was a result of portfolio realignment by foreign fund managers moving out of property stocks.
"Its a technical respite as ALIB has been up the past few weeks," said Helen Alvarez, vice-president at Citytrust Investment Bank.
A total of 4.07 million ALI B shares worth 119.6 million pesos changed hands after an hour of trade.
